name: Mathematics for EDA
description: The mathematics the EDA curriculum builds on: discrete mathematics and logic, graph theory, linear algebra, numerical analysis, probability, ODEs and optimization, as far as the EDA graph needs them.

name: The EDA Landscape
description: What electronic design automation is, the RTL-to-GDSII flow stage by stage, the representations each stage consumes and produces, PPA, the industry and its history.

name: Boolean Reasoning and Complexity
description: Boolean functions, cofactors, Shannon expansion, covers and clauses, and the complexity theory that explains why every EDA problem needs heuristics.

name: Graph Algorithms for EDA
description: Netlists as hypergraphs, partitioning (KL, FM, multilevel, spectral), shortest paths and A*, flows, Steiner trees and the graph machinery under placement, routing and timing.

name: Computational Geometry for Layout
description: Rectilinear geometry, polygon Booleans, plane sweep and spatial indexes: the kernels under DRC, extraction, fill and routing.

name: Optimization for EDA
description: LP, ILP, convex and nonconvex optimization, Lagrangian relaxation, metaheuristics, dynamic programming and Bayesian optimization, each tied to the EDA problem it solves.

name: Numerical Methods for EDA
description: Sparse linear algebra, Newton's method, stiff ODE integration, Krylov solvers, PDE discretization and model order reduction for simulators and analyzers.

name: Variability, Yield and Reliability Statistics
description: Monte Carlo and rare-event estimation, process variation, statistical timing mathematics, yield models and lifetime statistics.

name: Circuits and Electromagnetics
description: Circuit laws, RC and RLC dynamics, transfer functions, transmission lines, S-parameters and the field physics behind parasitics and signal integrity.

name: Semiconductor Devices and Compact Models
description: Band theory, carrier transport, junctions, MOSFET physics, FinFETs and nanosheets, reliability and the compact models EDA tools consume.

name: Digital Logic Design
description: Combinational and sequential logic, flip-flop timing, FSMs, adders and multipliers, pipelines and memories, for a mathematician entering hardware.

name: Fabrication and Design-Technology Co-optimization
description: Process steps, lithography, OPC and multiple patterning, the interconnect stack, PDKs and design rules, DTCO and yield.

name: CMOS Circuits and Cell Libraries
description: Static CMOS, logical effort, power, standard-cell layout and the Liberty abstraction every digital tool consumes.

name: HDLs and Hardware Compilers
description: Verilog, SystemVerilog and VHDL semantics, elaboration, ASTs, IRs, SSA and dataflow analysis, RTLIL, MLIR and CIRCT.

name: Logic Synthesis
description: Two-level and multi-level minimization, don't cares, AIGs and rewriting, FSM synthesis, retiming, e-graphs, Yosys and ABC.

name: Formal Verification
description: SAT and CDCL, BDDs, equivalence checking, model checking, BMC, k-induction, IC3, SMT and assertions.

name: Functional Verification and Simulation
description: Event-driven and compiled simulation, testbenches, constrained random, coverage, UVM, emulation and CDC.

name: Circuit Simulation
description: Modified nodal analysis, Newton with companion models, transient integration and step control, AC, PSS, Monte Carlo and model order reduction.

name: Technology Mapping and Sizing
description: Tree and DAG covering, cuts, LUT mapping, Boolean matching, gate sizing and buffer insertion.

name: High-Level Synthesis
description: CDFGs, scheduling, allocation and binding, pipelining and modulo scheduling, from algorithm to RTL.

name: Static Timing Analysis
description: Timing graphs, delay models, clocks and constraints, OCV, AOCV, POCV and SSTA, incremental timing and timing closure.

name: Test and Design for Test
description: Fault models, fault simulation, ATPG, scan and compression, BIST, JTAG, diagnosis and yield learning.

name: Floorplanning and Placement
description: Floorplan representations, wirelength models, quadratic and electrostatic placement, legalization, detailed and timing-driven placement.

name: Analog, Mixed-Signal and RF Design Automation
description: Small-signal design, op-amps, data converters and PLLs, sizing as optimization, matching and analog layout, RF and mixed-signal simulation.

name: FPGA CAD
description: FPGA architecture, packing, annealing placement, PathFinder routing and open FPGA toolchains.

name: Clock Trees and Power Delivery
description: Clock tree synthesis, zero-skew and useful skew, clock gating, power grids, IR drop, decap, EM and low-power intent.

name: Routing
description: Maze and A* routing, pattern and global routing, negotiated congestion, layer assignment, detailed and channel routing.

name: Extraction, Signal Integrity and Signoff
description: Parasitic extraction, SPEF, RC reduction, crosstalk and noise, ECOs and the signoff checklist.

name: Physical Verification and DFM
description: GDSII and OASIS, DRC engines, LVS as graph matching, antenna and fill, hotspots and tape-out.

name: PCB Design
description: Schematic to layout, stackups and controlled impedance, differential pairs, vias, manufacturing outputs and board-level SI.

name: Packaging, Chiplets and 3D Integration
description: Flip chip and BGA, interposers, TSVs, hybrid bonding, UCIe, thermal, mechanical and reliability physics.

name: Building EDA Software
description: Design databases, format parsers, incremental computation, deterministic parallelism, regression and QoR, and the open-source RTL-to-GDS flow hands-on.

name: Machine Learning for EDA
description: GNNs on netlists, congestion and timing prediction, RL placement and its debate, surrogates and Bayesian optimization, LLMs for RTL.

name: Agent-First EDA Architecture
description: Engines built for agents: the four-layer model, skills and harness loops, change tiers and seams, golden tests, the skill flywheel, tool-grounded RL and agentic signoff.

name: 4th Grade Math
description: Multi-digit arithmetic, negative numbers, fractions, decimals, lines and angles in geometry.

name: 5th Grade Math
description: Arithmetic with fractions and decimals. Solve real-world problems involving measurement, data, and geometry.

name: 6th Grade Math
description: Ratios, percentages, fraction division, expressions, equations, geometry, and statistics.

name: 7th Grade Math
description: Proportional relationships, multi-step equations, geometry, statistics, and probability.

name: 8th Grade Math
description: Exponents, scientific notation, equations, graphs, functions, geometry, and transformations.

name: Prealgebra
description: Variables, linear equations and inequalities, systems of equations, expressions, ratios, and the distributive property.

name: Algebra I
description: Functions, graphing, linear and quadratic equations, factoring, exponents, and systems.

name: Geometry
description: Length, area, and volume. Relationships between angles and side lengths in right triangles. Coordinate geometry.

name: Algebra II
description: Advanced functions: quadratics, logarithms, trigonometry, and polynomials. Complex numbers and sequences.

name: Precalculus
description: Functions, polynomials, rational and exponential functions, conics, vectors, parametric and polar curves, sequences and series, and advanced trigonometry.

name: Calculus I
description: Limits, continuity, derivatives, differentiation rules and applications, and definite integrals.

name: Calculus II
description: Integration techniques, improper integrals, sequences and series, power and Taylor series.

name: Calculus III
description: Multivariable and vector calculus: parametrised curves, curvature, line integrals, multiple integrals and the Jacobian.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, determinants, systems, eigenvalues, spans and bases, linear transformations, inner products, and matrix decompositions.

name: Discrete Math
description: Logic, sets, combinatorics, graphs, recurrence, and induction.

name: Discrete Math II
description: De Morgan, relations, pigeonhole, Eulerian, and strong induction.

name: Probability & Statistics
description: Descriptive statistics, probability, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, and the tests built on them.

name: Number Theory
description: Divisibility, primes, modular arithmetic, Euler's theorem, quadratic residues, continued fractions, and cryptography.

name: Differential Equations
description: First and second order ODEs, series and numerical methods, systems, applications, and the Laplace transform.

name: Abstract Algebra
description: Groups, subgroups, homomorphisms, rings, and fields.

name: Abstract Algebra II
description: Normal subgroups, Lagrange, quotient groups, polynomial rings, and field extensions.

name: Topology
description: Metric spaces, open and closed sets, continuity, compactness, connectedness, and an introduction to algebraic topology.

name: Machine Learning
description: Vector foundations and backpropagation through neural networks.

name: Complex Numbers and Analysis
description: Complex arithmetic and geometry, polar and exponential form, roots, and the beginnings of complex analysis.

name: Graph Theory
description: Isomorphism, connectivity, matchings, coloring, planarity, spectra, extremal graphs, and flows.

name: Probability Theory
description: The axioms, conditional probability, random variables, distributions, generating functions and limit theorems.

name: Numerical Analysis
description: Error and conditioning, root finding, interpolation and approximation, quadrature, and numerical linear algebra.

name: Real Analysis
description: The completeness of the real line, sequences and series, limits and continuity, and the core theorems of the calculus, developed rigorously.
